metadata.title: That 1 kill where I was definitely NOT aiming but Valorant said ‘Here, take this!’
metadata.description:
Clicked like I was swatting a fly and somehow scored.
Enemy probably uninstalling to rethink life choices.
Valorant logic: handing out freebies on a silver platter.
Tap if your aim’s chaos but kills keep rolling!

Hit like if your aim’s a mess but you still get that lucky kill!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckykill #funnygaming #shorts
